item.title: EdgeQ Technologies Private Limited: AI Infrastructure Specialist
item.skills: AWS, Bash, Docker, Google Cloud, Python, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Terraform
item.description:
Headquarters: United States

AI Infrastructure Specialist

Job Title: AI Infrastructure Specialist
Location: United States (Remote)
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Experience: 2–6 Years
Salary Range: $95,000 – $155,000 per year (USD)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Category: Artificial Intelligence / Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced AI Infrastructure Specialist to join our growing technology team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, building, deploying, and maintaining scalable infrastructure to support AI and machine learning workloads.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, GPU computing, containerization, Kubernetes, MLOps, and AI model deployment. This role involves optimizing infrastructure performance, ensuring scalability, and supporting reliable AI-powered applications.

This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain scalable infrastructure for AI and machine learning applications.

  • Manage cloud-based AI infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Configure and optimize GPU-based computing environments for AI workloads.

  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes clusters and Docker containers.

  • Support AI model training, deployment, and inference environments.

  • Build and maintain MLOps pipelines for continuous integration and deployment.

  • Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, scalability, and resource utilization.

  • Optimize GPU, CPU, memory, and storage resources for AI workloads.

  • Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.

  • Collaborate with AI engineers, ML engineers, and DevOps teams.

  • Implement infrastructure security, access controls, and monitoring solutions.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and ensure system reliability.

  • Maintain technical documentation and infrastructure best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of experience in AI Infrastructure, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Understanding of GPU computing and AI workload optimization.

  • Experience with Linux administration and system troubleshooting.

  • Knowledge of Python, Bash, or Shell scripting.

  • Familiarity with machine learning model deployment and inference workflows.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.

  • Knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure tools.

  • Understanding of networking, storage, and cloud security fundamentals.

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience with NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and GPU resource management.

  • Familiarity with MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, or similar MLOps frameworks.

  • Knowledge of LLM deployment and inference optimization.

  • Experience with distributed computing and high-performance computing (HPC).

  • Familiarity with serverless AI infrastructure and microservices architecture.

  • Understanding of model serving frameworks such as NVIDIA Triton, vLLM, or TorchServe.

  • Experience managing large-scale AI infrastructure environments.

Salary & Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $95,000 – $155,000 USD.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise.

  • 100% remote work opportunity.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid time off and holidays.

  • Retirement savings benefits, where applicable.

  • Professional development and technical certification support.

  • Career advancement opportunities.

Work Location

United States – Fully Remote

  • Candidates from eligible locations across the United States are encouraged to apply.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Ability to collaborate with distributed engineering teams across different US time zones.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with contact details, relevant AI Infrastructure experience, and certifications or project portfolios.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse professional backgrounds and encourage applications from eligible candidates across the United States.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/edgeq-technologies-private-limited-ai-infrastructure-specialist

item.title: Knack: Cloud Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

Overview

Edgewater Federal Solutions is seeking an experienced Full-Stack Platform Engineer. The Full-Stack Platform Engineer provides senior technical leadership and hands-on engineering for a secure enterprise data analytics platform supporting a federal environment. The role designs and delivers scalable web applications, APIs, data integrations, cloud solutions, and secure development practices while guiding technical decisions and resolving complex platform issues.

 

*Due to the nature of the work and contract - US Citizenship is required.

*This is a remote role.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture, design, and development of full-stack solutions using React, Node.js/Express, Python (Flask/FastAPI), REST APIs, and advanced SQL.
  • Design and support cloud-based data integrations, ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks or equivalent analytics services, and data quality capabilities.
  • Establish secure engineering and DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD, automated security testing, containerization, infrastructure as code, and code reviews.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities, including LLM APIs, RAG patterns, prompt engineering, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Architect solutions within AWS using appropriate IAM, networking, secrets management, encryption, logging, and security controls.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, support production troubleshooting, and communicate technical recommendations to stakeholders.

 

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes or ECS, Terraform, Git, and automated security tooling.
  • Knowledge of application security, IAM/RBAC, OWASP practices, observability, and secure cloud architecture.
  • Experience supporting federal or regulated environments and familiarity with FISMA, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, and ATO processes.

Additional benefits include:

Working at Edgewater Federal Solutions:

Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services, and timely delivery. Edgewater Federal Solutions is ISO 9001, 20000-1, 270001 certified, appraised at CMMI Level 3 Maturity for Development and Services, and has been named in the Top Workplaces in the Greater Washington Area Small Companies since 2018.

item.title: Halcyon: Senior Backend Cloud Engineer
item.skills: AWS, Python, Scala, Kubernetes, DynamoDB, Kafka, API Development, Rust, and Distributed Systems
item.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.halcyon.ai

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role  

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.  

Responsibilities  

  • Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. 
  • Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. 
  • Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. 
  • Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. 
  • Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.  
  • Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. 
  • Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.  

Skills and Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.  
  • A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. 
  • Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. 
  • Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).  
  • Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.  
  • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.  
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.  

Bonus Skills and Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala.  
  • Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores). 
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.  
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).  
  • Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.  
  • Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).  
  • Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.  
  • Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration. 

Benefits:

 Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

  • 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

  • Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

  • Medical and dependent care FSA options.

  • Flexible PTO policy.

  • Parental leave.

  • Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $170,000

Bonus Target: 10%

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

item.title: Salesloft: Salesforce Business Systems Administrator
item.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

ROLE: Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you.  

You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success. 

On a day to day basis, you will: 

  • Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated
  • Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results
  • Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub

This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement. 

THE SKILL SET

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years experience in a related role, Software (SaaS) experience is a plus
  • 2-3 years experience administering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Knowledge, Live Agent, and Customer Communities preferred
  • Salesforce Administrator certification is required
  • Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant certification is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience designing, revising and managing Salesforce Flows
  • Ability to lead teams through change management and business transformations
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to collaborate with management and others in the company
  • Disciplined, flexible, and autonomous work habits; we don't micromanage
  • Understanding of the SaaS business model and culture is a plus

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
